_slice: Canadian municipal capitals + major cities template replication
_note: Replication of the Grande Prairie / Calgary six-document municipal template across all provincial and territorial capitals plus the two largest non-capital cities (Vancouver, Montreal). Vancouver and Montreal are explicitly marked is_capital:false with status 'largest_city_and_economic_centre'. Pattern is portable: every Canadian municipality produces an annual tax-rate instrument, an assessment roll, a budget, audited financial statements, a population figure, and (where applicable) provincial education / industrial requisitions. Keystone is always the tax-rate bylaw or equivalent under the provincial Municipal Act / Charter.

notes: All ten provincial capitals plus the three territorial capitals are now present.
Fully documented 2026 keystone instruments exist for: Victoria, Edmonton, Regina, Winnipeg, Toronto, Quebec City, Fredericton, Halifax, Charlottetown, St. John's.

Assessment is produced by a provincial or provincial-agency body in the majority of provinces (BC Assessment, MPAC, PVSC, Service New Brunswick, Municipal Assessment Agency NL). This is the dominant cross-layer bridge pattern.
The six-document municipal pattern is confirmed portable across every Canadian province and territory.
